body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized upright camera, 39 W x 57 H x 33 D mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact upright block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring upper right, flash window upper left, shutter top front-left, slide switch top rear right, USB-C in the bottom. Idea FRAME DRAGGING, a spinning black hole twisting space: three thick satin light-grey tubes wind round the matte black core as a helix, calm and parallel at the bottom, a quarter turn up the left grip side, then dragged tight into a whirl round the lens ring. The twist is the grip: diagonal grooves between tubes follow the slant of fingers closing round an upright body, three finger channels. Tube ends rise as a collar round the shutter, a flat ring foot frames the USB-C so it stands in a dock, one tube end loops out at the bottom rear corner as eyelet; ribbed thumb pad on the back. image[2] = upright soft tube camera. image[3] = lines bending round a form, for the twist. image[4] = field-line grooves on the core. image[5] = ribbed ring with red index, for the lens. Engraved ticks, fine vents, sliding back door. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
